utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard the repair drive is picking up, and I’m still catching up on the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still sorting out the details for the repair drive, right? Tell me what’s needed and I’ll see what I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear — sounds like the repair drive is off to a solid start. I’ll keep my eyes open in case they still need anything while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — if you spot any gaps, just let me know and I’ll keep the supply list updated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll send you the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details too—once I’ve got them, I’ll let you know exactly what help we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s still going okay, but I may have missed the latest changes. If Mina has the updated details, I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — just tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll bring over my tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’d like to double-check the repair drive details first: what exactly do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, but I’ll let you know exactly what help we need as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll pitch in. I might need a quick reminder, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you start with the broken chairs and any loose shelves? That would help a lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what needs fixing first, and when are we heading over?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping an eye on the supply list for the repair drive—just let me know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll check the list after drop-off and send you anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s on Sunday at the community center now, and I’m keeping the list updated. If you hear of any urgent repairs, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’ll pass along anything urgent I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just send me the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, so I don’t have the time and place yet—could you share them with me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Bo — it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll spread the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll check on the boxes and the drop-off spot today and let you know. Once I confirm it, we can sort out the timing.
